items.exampleEn: I borrow books from the library.
My father works in a car factory.
items.exampleZh: 我爸爸在汽車工廠工作。

items.exampleEn: There is a sign on the post.
You can see the sea from the top of the tower.
There is a flag on the school building.
items.exampleZh: 學校大樓上有一面旗子。

items.exampleEn: We play in the park after school.
Many people visit the old temple.
items.exampleZh: 很多人去參觀那座老廟。

items.exampleEn: The palace is very old and beautiful.

items.sentenceEn: The library is in the park.

items.audioEn: Let's meet at the temple near the park at ten.
items.audioZh: 我們十點在公園附近的那座廟碰面吧。

items.sentenceEn: A bird is sitting on the post.
Please be quiet in the library.

items.stemEn: I go to the ____ to read books for free.
The king lives in a big ____.
items.stemZh: 國王住在一座大宮殿裡。

items.passageEn: Our town is small, but it has many interesting places. There is an old temple, a park, and a library. On top of the hill, there is a tall tower with a big flag. From the tower, you can see the factory and the river.
items.passageZh: 我們鎮雖然小，但有很多有趣的地方：一座老廟、一座公園和一間圖書館。山丘頂上有一座高塔，塔上掛著一面大旗子。從塔上可以看到工廠和河流。

referenceEn: I often go to the library to study.
I often study at the library.
rubricZh: 「去圖書館」用 go to the library；寫 study at the library 也正確
often 常放在一般動詞前，也可放句尾

items.instructionZh: 用 park 造一個句子，說說你在公園做什麼。
referenceEn: I walk my dog in the park.
I like to run in the park in the morning.
rubricZh: 「在公園」例如 in the park（at the park 也正確）
